name: Royal Orchid Hotel (Thailand) Public Company Limited
summary: Royal Orchid Hotel (Thailand) Public Company Limited runs a hospitality venue in Thailand, providing a comprehensive array of amenities for its patrons. These offerings include diverse accommodation choices, various food and beverage services, and dedicated banquet facilities. The company serves a wide range of customers, encompassing business professionals, leisure tourists, and travel agencies. Established in 1978, its principal operations are based in Bangkok, Thailand. This enterprise operates as a subsidiary of Grande Asset Hotels and Property Public Company Limited.
